name: Narumi Hotaru
source: Yuma's classmate who's always reading with a calm and cool personality. Like Airi she prefers anime, doujinshi and games and will sometimes read together with her in the Library. Participating in the Sex Royale gives her an opportunity to fulfil her rape fantasies with Yuma. Despite her cool personality she acts like the proper heroine being raped or acting as a rapist when the situation demands [spoiler]until she becomes pregnant and has to drop out of the Sex Royale[/spoiler]. Especially enjoys BL situations.
